_doc: Documented statuses no Bruno request can assert on its own response, with the reason. Read by build.py and api/bruno_coverage_test.go. Add an entry only when the status cannot be caused from outside a healthy stack.

getMe.429: Asserted in S6.12 on the burst's own 429 sample (pre-request calls), not on S6.12's own response, which is tenant B's 200.
getMe.500: Needs an internal failure (a dependency error mid-request); not caused from outside a healthy stack. Unit tests cover the mapping (internal/platform/apihttp).
getMe.501: getMe is implemented; 501 is the generated default for an unimplemented operation.

onboardTenant.429: Reserved, not emitted: operator routes carry no tenant, so the per-tenant limiter (ADR-001 D6) does not wrap them (internal/server/api.go). Kept in the contract because removing a response breaks the additive-only rule (check-openapi). TICK-516.
onboardTenant.500: Needs a Keycloak or database failure mid-onboarding; not caused from outside a healthy stack.

listEntityTypes.429: Not asserted here: the limiter is route-agnostic and asserted on getMe in S6.12; internal/server/write_chain_test.go (P2) drives it on every tenant write route.
listEntityTypes.500: Needs an internal failure (a dependency error mid-request); not caused from outside a healthy stack.
listEntityTypes.501: The operation is implemented; 501 is the generated default for an unimplemented operation, or nava-core started without a database or cursor keys.
